headline_item.title_zh: 黄仁勋陷婚外情舆论漩涡
headline_item.title_en: Sources: Jensen Huang had an extramarital relationship with Nvidia's VP of healthcare, Kimberly Powell; their relationship has been discussed inside the company (New York Times)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 黄仁勋被曝与英伟达医疗业务副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔存在婚外关系，该八卦在公司内部已成公开讨论话题
headline_item.event_summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is allegedly involved in an extramarital affair with Kimberly Powell, the company's VP of healthcare. The relationship has become a subject of discussion within the company, challenging the corporate image of its leadership.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达CEO黄仁勋、医疗业务副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔在英伟达公司内部：被曝存在婚外情，且相关讨论在公司内部流传
【起因与机理】作为行业领袖的私人操守受到公众及内部审查
【关键技术规格】黄仁勋与医疗健康副总裁曝出不正当关系。
【观点态度】高管私德引发市场及舆论关注。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Jensen Huang (CEO) and Kimberly Powell (VP of Healthcare) (Inside Nvidia): Alleged extramarital affair and internal gossip
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Scrutiny over leadership ethics and corporate conduct
[Key Specification] Jensen Huang and VP of Healthcare involved in alleged affair.
[Perspective & Impact] Executive conduct sparks public and market concern.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 老黄这回算是明白了，除了算力不够，防火防盗防身边高管才是企业安全的最高境界。当“医疗健康”副总裁成了“私生活健康”的挑战者，英伟达的股价除了跌，估计还得加点八卦的情绪溢价。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Jensen Huang finally realizes that besides compute power, the real risk to corporate security is the VP sitting next to you. When the 'Healthcare' VP starts affecting 'personal life health,' Nvidia's stock might need a new category for gossip-induced volatility.

headlines.title_zh: 美联航封杀AI代理自动订票
headlines.title_en: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美联航以隐私与监管合规为由，禁止AI代理代表用户直接购买机票，仅保留展示功能
headlines.event_summary_en: United Airlines has officially blocked AI agents from finalizing flight bookings on its platform. The company cites concerns over potential privacy breaches, unauthorized transactions, and the inability of AI to fulfill mandatory federal regulatory obligations, such as dangerous goods declarations.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美联航 (United Airlines)在美联航票务预订平台：禁止AI代理完成机票支付交易，仅允许展示航班信息
【起因与机理】规避隐私泄露风险，应对联邦政府关于航空安全及合规声明的监管要求
【关键技术规格】美联航封禁AI代买机票功能。
【观点态度】AI代理目前仍能查询航班但无法闭环完成交易。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] United Airlines (United booking platform): Banning AI agents from completing transactions while allowing flight discovery
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Mitigating privacy risks and ensuring compliance with federal safety regulations
[Key Specification] United Airlines restricts AI agent bookings.
[Perspective & Impact] AI agents limited to flight discovery only.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI代理想帮人类省钱省心，结果被航司以‘不能保证你没带炸弹’为由关进小黑屋。这本质上是旧世界的门卫在AI时代继续玩权力游戏，毕竟如果AI能自动订最便宜的票，谁来给那些昂贵的差价买单呢？
headlines.industry_impact_en: AI agents trying to save us time are getting gatekept by airlines claiming they can't verify we aren't carrying explosives. It’s just the old-guard gatekeepers pulling rank; they’d much rather you deal with their clunky UI than let an AI algorithm find the best deal for your wallet.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
